evidence.quote: the rehearsal is tomorrow at nine

questions.explanation_en: Maya tells Leo the rehearsal is tomorrow at nine. Friday is when the play opens, not the rehearsal.
questions.explanation_pt: A Maya avisa que o ensaio é amanhã às nove. Sexta-feira é a estreia da peça, não o ensaio.

questions.prompt: Complete what Maya says: "Relax. I'll _____ Jordan right now."
questions.explanation_en: Maya says she will text Jordan, which means sending him a message on her phone.
questions.explanation_pt: A Maya diz que vai mandar uma mensagem ("text") para o Jordan pelo celular.

evidence.quote: Not yet. I'm swamped with the set design.

questions.prompt: Leo has already finished rewriting the second act.
questions.explanation_en: When Maya asks, Leo answers "Not yet": he is still busy with the set design.
questions.explanation_pt: Quando a Maya pergunta, o Leo responde "Not yet" (ainda não): ele continua ocupado com o cenário.

evidence.quote: I'm swamped with the set design.

questions.prompt: Leo says he is "swamped". What does he mean?
questions.explanation_en: "Swamped" means having so much work that you can hardly handle it.
questions.explanation_pt: "Swamped" quer dizer estar atolado de trabalho, sem tempo para mais nada.

evidence.quote: figure it out before Friday, or we're cutting the king's scene

questions.prompt: According to Ms. Park, what will happen if the crown is not found before Friday?

options.text: The king's scene will be cut
Jordan will have to pay for it

questions.explanation_en: Ms. Park warns that if they don't solve the problem before Friday, they will cut the king's scene.
questions.explanation_pt: A Ms. Park avisa que, se o problema não for resolvido até sexta, a cena do rei será cortada.

evidence.quote: Again? You said that last week.

questions.prompt: What does Maya's reaction suggest about Leo?

options.text: He often does things at the last minute
He usually finishes his work very early
He has already rewritten the second act
He does not care about the rehearsal

questions.explanation_en: Maya says "Again?" because Leo also planned to stay up all night last week, so it is a habit.
questions.explanation_pt: A Maya diz "Again?" (de novo?) porque o Leo já tinha feito isso na semana anterior: virou hábito.

questions.prompt: In this context, what does "pull an all-nighter" mean?

options.text: Stay awake all night to finish something
Go out and party until the morning
Sleep at school before the rehearsal
Cancel a plan at the last minute

questions.explanation_en: To "pull an all-nighter" is to stay up the whole night working or studying, usually because of a deadline.
questions.explanation_pt: "Pull an all-nighter" é virar a noite trabalhando ou estudando, normalmente por causa de um prazo.

questions.prompt: What is Leo doing when he says "And it worked, didn't it?"

options.text: Defending his last-minute way of working
Admitting that his plan failed last week
Asking Maya to help him tonight

questions.explanation_en: With this tag question, Leo defends himself: staying up all night worked last week, so he sees no problem.
questions.explanation_pt: Com essa pergunta retórica, o Leo se defende: virar a noite funcionou na semana passada, então ele não vê problema.
